parsed.post: Massive improvement! Increased capacity with DEPTH=8 and found that MATRIX_LR 0.06 was a regression, but a different configuration (implied) or perhaps a better balance just hit 1.0064. Keeping this. Next: testing if increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 or adjusting WARMUP_RATIO can squeeze even more performance out of this deep architecture.
parsed.description: Testing a combination of higher ASPECT_RATIO (64) and a small WARMUP_RATIO (0.05) to see if we can stabilize and further improve the current best result.
